exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/05-工具使用.md
exercises.question_zh: 给离线harness增加股票查询，应验证什么？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: 增加股票查询可在离线表里验证工具注册、描述、参数和fake路由；真实行情、证券建议、外部API未做。参考核对必须把静态价格标fixture，并保留source/as_of。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/05-工具使用.md
exercises.question_zh: 必填缺失和额外键怎样处理？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: 缺必填拒绝；额外键采用任务显式合同，默认不能悄悄吞掉影响范围的输入。错误发生在executor之前，记录调用ID与typed error。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/05-工具使用.md
exercises.question_zh: 如何区分只读/副作用并形成真实批准门禁？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: 把read-only/deterministic/side-effect/authorization分别标注；不可只输出确认提示。写fixture验证未批准时执行计数为零。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/05-工具使用.md
exercises.question_zh: 为客户端画四步环，谁回填、谁执行？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: 四步图区分模型决定与宿主执行，宿主写历史、模型看结果；MCP服务器负责能力不替客户端产生用户授权。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/05-工具使用.md
exercises.question_zh: 官方guide的请求控制字段增加什么？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: 原题“唯一请求字段”没有唯一答案；tool_choice是可选控制，auto/required/forced/none改变是否提出调用，不属于执行授权。要求答题者指定官方接口和引用字段，不按预设唯一字段判分。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/05-工具使用.md
exercises.question_zh: 三家适配新增enum应核什么？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: 三种声明保留内部工具语义，enum与nullable经目标支持子集转换；打印JSON相同只证明本地转换，不证明网络验收。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/05-工具使用.md
exercises.question_zh: 发现工具列表能写成通用ListToolsResponse吗？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: 提供商函数列表通常是应用提供；MCP tools/list是独立协议。先定义发现对象和返回合同，不能编一个不存在的通用ListToolsResponse并称官方API。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/05-工具使用.md
exercises.question_zh: auto/required/none/force怎样迁移？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: 内部auto/required/none/force映射每家当前入口，强制工具仍不授权执行；原代码已写四种转换，不把原练习当新增完成。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/05-工具使用.md
exercises.question_zh: 举一个不同provider不通用的字段。
exercises.answer_or_criterion: 指定一家官方文档的具体字段/接口/日期解释差异；本次已核OpenAI strict、Chat与Responses封装。其它提供商端到端文档及真实调用仍待验。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/05-工具使用.md
exercises.question_zh: 同一违规参数在三家validator的结果能说明什么？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: 用同一违规参数测本地validator只能比较本地检查，不是提供商strictness实验。报告拒绝位置、错误路径及本地支持范围，不推荐未测赢家。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/05-工具使用.md
exercises.question_zh: 改变延迟时何时max/sum模型失效？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: 改变延迟时对照max/sum并说明调度开销；一个调用远慢于其余或短调用开销占主导时收益小，不能说常数收益随工具数必增长。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/05-工具使用.md
exercises.question_zh: 取消中途片段怎样形成终态？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: 取消必须丢弃缓冲且禁止后来stop/delta触发执行；finish_reason length是截断不是成功完成。具体provider取消语义须单独核官方协议，本次未作。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/05-工具使用.md
exercises.question_zh: asyncio与线程池如何公平比较？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: asyncio与threadpool只在相同工作量和真实/模拟I/O条件下比较；不能预设async一定更快。本阶段均未执行。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/05-工具使用.md
exercises.question_zh: create/write依赖怎样影响fanout？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: create→write依赖边；同路径write/delete资源冲突；按DAG与限流组建就绪集合，缺安全信息默认不并发。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/05-工具使用.md
exercises.question_zh: 何时应禁并行，是否只有同对象mutation？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: consequential same resource 是重要禁并行案例但不是唯一；需说明数据依赖、冲突、非幂等与下游限流并引目标官方条件。本次没有真实provider实验。

exercises.answer_or_criterion: oneOf恰好一个分支通过，discriminator可降低歧义；本地未支持则提前拒绝，不悄悄忽略。OpenAI当前嵌套anyOf支持不意味着oneOf无条件可用。

exercises.answer_or_criterion: Pydantic schema diff不应预设“唯一默认字段”；记录目标版本、ref/defs、title/default及required/nullable差异。未安装/运行Pydantic。

exercises.question_zh: 把不受strict支持的约束重构，怎样保业务正确？

source_options: Carry only current-round inputResponses and signed phase state on each fresh retry
Reuse the original request id until completion
Accumulate all model responses in a hidden session
quiz.source_reference_answer: Carry only current-round inputResponses and signed phase state on each fresh retry
quiz.source_explanation: Each retry is self-contained. Signed requestState carries validated intermediate state, and inputResponses contains only the current round.

quiz.source_question: A user declines a deletion elicitation. What is the safe result?
source_options: Delete because the model already selected the note
Treat the missing content as implicit consent
Return a complete non-error refusal outcome and preserve the note
Repeat the same dialog until the user accepts
quiz.source_reference_answer: Return a complete non-error refusal outcome and preserve the note
quiz.source_explanation: Decline is explicit refusal. It must not be converted into consent, error-loop prompting, or mutation.
quiz.judgment_criterion: decline保数据且不强问；完整无误refusal是可选应用策略

quiz.source_question: Which design safely binds a destructive confirmation to what the user saw?
source_options: Base64-encode the chosen note id without a signature
Sign the principal, original argument digest, candidate ids, phase, and expiry, then re-check the live target
Use clientInfo as the authoritative user identity
Trust any note id returned with action accept
quiz.source_reference_answer: Sign the principal, original argument digest, candidate ids, phase, and expiry, then re-check the live target
quiz.source_explanation: Integrity-protected state prevents tampering. A shared atomic one-time nonce claim prevents replay, while final live checks address races before mutation.

Store progress only in initialize state
Require every client to use sticky load balancing
Return an explicit durable task handle backed by application storage

quiz.question: Which MCP field is safe to use as an authenticated client identity?
options: None of the self-reported clientInfo fields
clientInfo.name
clientInfo.version
clientCapabilities
quiz.source_explanation: Client information and capabilities are protocol metadata, not authentication evidence.
quiz.answer_zh: A：都不能。自报名称、版本和能力不是认证证据。

quiz.question: What should a gateway hash after approving a tool?
options: The canonical complete descriptor, including description, schema, and relevant annotations
Only the tool name
Only the server display name
The current session identifier
quiz.source_explanation: Whole-descriptor pinning detects schema and annotation changes that a description-only hash misses.
quiz.answer_zh: A：规范化完整descriptor，涵盖description/schema/相关annotations，避免只改schema漏检。

targets.file: Agentic Design Patterns/06-专题扩展/07-工具授权与发布治理.md
targets.heading: 6.6 五课30道自检题的中文参考判断

quiz.question: How should a gateway expose two backend tools both named search?
options: Ask the model to infer the server
Randomly choose a backend
Use stable qualified names such as notes.search and issues.search
Keep the last discovered tool
quiz.source_explanation: Qualified names make routing, approval, auditing, and header validation refer to one stable tool.
quiz.answer_zh: C：稳定限定名称和显式路由映射；碰撞拒绝或重新命名，不随机选择。

targets.file: Agentic Design Patterns/06-专题扩展/07-工具授权与发布治理.md
targets.heading: 6.6 五课30道自检题的中文参考判断

quiz.question: Which client capability declarations support an MCP form elicitation?
options: Either elicitation: {} implicitly or elicitation: {form: {}} explicitly
Any non-empty extensions object
Only a protocol session with form enabled
Only elicitation.url
quiz.source_explanation: An empty elicitation object implies form support, while form: {} states it explicitly. URL-only support is insufficient for a form request.
quiz.answer_zh: A：`elicitation:{}`隐含form，或显式`elicitation:{form:{}}`；只有url不够。具体wire见通信06。

targets.heading: 6.6 五课30道自检题的中文参考判断

quiz.question: Why must requestState be integrity protected and bound to exact arguments?
options: To select a cache scope
To replace OAuth
To stop a client from reusing or altering confirmation for another action
To make JSON smaller
quiz.source_explanation: requestState round-trips through an untrusted peer, so the server must detect tampering and context changes. A shared atomic nonce claim prevents reuse across handler instances.
quiz.answer_zh: C：防止确认被篡改或用于另一动作；还要绑定主体/政策/对象与原子nonce消费。

targets.heading: 6.6 五课30道自检题的中文参考判断

quiz.question: Which is the correct order for a modern gateway?
options: Trust clientInfo, execute, then audit
Accept declared capabilities as permission
Authenticate, validate wire and headers, check capability compatibility, authorize, then execute
Create a session, route by discovery order, then authorize
quiz.source_explanation: Wire ambiguity and identity must be resolved before authorization and execution.
quiz.answer_zh: C：认证、wire与header校验、能力兼容、对象授权、执行；这些步骤不能互相代替。

quiz.question: What must a client do with an authorization response iss value?
options: Normalize it and compare hostnames
Store it as clientInfo
Ignore it after PKCE succeeds
Compare it exactly with the recorded issuer before using the response
quiz.source_explanation: RFC 9207 issuer checking prevents authorization response mix-up between issuers.
quiz.answer_zh: D：与发起时可信记录的issuer精确比较，不能只比host或依赖PKCE。

quiz.question: How should a client key issuer-minted OAuth credentials and access tokens?
options: Issuer-minted credentials by issuer and tokens by issuer plus resource
All registrations and tokens under one global client name
By the server display name only
By protocol session identifier
quiz.source_explanation: Issuer and resource keys prevent minted credentials from crossing security authorities or audiences. A self-hosted CIMD URL remains portable.
quiz.answer_zh: A：issuer签发的凭证按issuer，token按issuer加resource；可移植CIMD URL另论。

quiz.question: A resource returns 403 with scope notes:delete. What is the correct next step?
options: Add notes:delete locally without authorization
Explain the scope, obtain consent, authorize for it, then retry with a new request id
Send the MCP token to a downstream API
Reuse the current token and ignore the challenge
quiz.source_explanation: Step-up obtains a newly authorized token before retrying the operation.
quiz.answer_zh: B：说明权限、取得同意、重新授权并拿新token，然后用新request ID重试。

https://notes.example.com/mcp/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource
quiz.source_explanation: RFC 9728 preserves the protected resource path after the well-known segment, so the /mcp suffix is required.
quiz.answer_zh: A：`https://notes.example.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp`，路径保留在well-known之后。

The last HTTP connection

No protocol session; each request carries the information needed to validate and route it

options: Open a GET stream first
Copy the outer bearer token and session id
Reuse the outer JSON-RPC id as durable state
Create a fresh self-contained request with gateway client metadata and mediated capabilities
quiz.source_explanation: The gateway is the backend's client and creates a new independently valid request.

options: Validate its publication shape, then join it to separate verified publisher, provenance, policy, and approval state
Treat publication as a completed security review
Copy verification claims from arbitrary record fields
Trust any record whose name looks familiar
quiz.source_explanation: server.json carries publication metadata. Verified provenance and the gateway's approval decision remain external admission evidence.
quiz.answer_zh: A：核发布结构，再与独立publisher/provenance/policy/approval证据关联。

Through resources/subscribe
Through a standalone GET with Last-Event-ID
Through notifications/initialized
quiz.source_explanation: subscriptions/listen replaces the old unsolicited GET and resource subscription model.
quiz.answer_zh: A：POST `subscriptions/listen`，响应SSE；不是旧独立GET或旧resources/subscribe。

quiz.question: An MCP client discovers a different authorization-server issuer for the same resource. What should it do with its existing registration and access token?
options: Reuse only the access token after changing its audience locally
Enroll for the new issuer and keep credentials isolated by issuer
Reuse both because the MCP resource URL did not change
Store both under the tool name instead of the issuer
quiz.source_explanation: Client identifiers and registration credentials belong to the authorization-server issuer that created them. An issuer change requires independent enrollment, and each access token is cached under both that issuer and its resource audience.
quiz.answer_zh: B：新issuer独立enroll，凭证按issuer隔离；不改本地aud来复用旧token。

quiz.question: Which enrollment approach is preferred by the MCP 2026-07-28 authorization profile?
options: RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration for every request
A Client ID Metadata Document served from the client's HTTPS URL
A protocol session that stores one global client identifier
A shared client secret embedded in every desktop client
quiz.source_explanation: CIMD lets the authorization server resolve client metadata from an HTTPS client identifier. DCR is deprecated and remains only for compatibility.
quiz.answer_zh: B：client HTTPS URL上的CIMD；不是全局共享secret或每请求DCR。

quiz.question: A deprecated DCR request describes a loopback desktop client. Which metadata is essential to classify it correctly?
options: Mcp-Session-Id
A wildcard redirect URI
application_type set to native
A reusable bearer token
quiz.source_explanation: Current compatibility guidance requires the correct application type. A loopback desktop client is native; web clients use HTTPS redirect URIs.
quiz.answer_zh: C：`application_type:native`，不是wildcard redirect。

quiz.question: Why does the client validate the RFC 9207 iss value before redeeming an authorization code?
options: To prevent redeeming an honest issuer's code at the wrong token endpoint
To avoid refreshing the JWKS cache
To replace PKCE with issuer discovery
To select a tool from server/discover
quiz.source_explanation: The issuer check defends against authorization-server mix-up. It complements PKCE by confirming the response came from the issuer recorded before redirect.
quiz.answer_zh: A：防授权服务器mix-up；与PKCE互补。

targets.file: Agentic Design Patterns/06-专题扩展/07-工具授权与发布治理.md
targets.heading: 6.6 五课30道自检题的中文参考判断

quiz.question: Where should an MCP resource server cache authorization for the current stateless transport?
options: Under Mcp-Session-Id until the client sends DELETE
Inside the server/discover result for all later calls
In the SSE connection until it reconnects
Nowhere as a protocol-session decision; validate the bearer token on every request
quiz.source_explanation: MCP 2026-07-28 removes protocol sessions. Each request crosses the authorization boundary independently, so identity, audience, expiry, and scope are checked each time.
quiz.answer_zh: D：每次请求核token/受众/有效期/scope和当前权限；受控认证cache不等协议session授权。

targets.heading: 6.6 五课30道自检题的中文参考判断

quiz.question: Which deployment evidence is strongest before trusting an authorization server?
options: The target server's discovered metadata checked against PKCE, issuer, enrollment, and resource-binding requirements
A vendor category table copied from an older lesson
A product page that says OAuth is supported
A successful login that does not inspect the token audience
quiz.source_explanation: Capabilities change by deployment and version. The live discovery document is the concrete contract to check, followed by end-to-end issuer and audience validation.
quiz.answer_zh: A：当前部署metadata与PKCE/issuer/enrollment/resource绑定及端到端结果；产品表或“支持OAuth”不够。

quiz.question: A team has a reusable review method and an existing API that supplies pull request data. Which design assigns each concern to the right primitive according to the runtime policy?
quiz.reference_judgment: A skill carries reusable procedural knowledge, while MCP exposes an external capability. They can compose. AGENTS.md is better for repository-wide defaults, and a hook responds to lifecycle events rather than replacing either layer.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: Why should a validator require the SKILL.md name to match its containing directory?
quiz.reference_judgment: Discovery tools frequently index a skill by both folder and frontmatter. Matching them prevents ambiguous catalog entries and broken installation paths. It does not grant authority or standardize a host's invocation UI.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: A SKILL.md contains a field that only one runtime understands. What is the portable interpretation?
quiz.reference_judgment: Portable core metadata and host runtime extensions are separate contracts. An adapter may recognize an extension, but a core validator should not claim that the field has universal semantics.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: Which primitive best represents a check that must run after every tool call?
quiz.reference_judgment: The defining requirement is event timing, so a lifecycle hook is the right mechanism. A skill may explain a workflow and MCP may expose a capability, but neither inherently fires after each tool call.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: When is AGENTS.md a better home than an Agent Skill?
quiz.reference_judgment: AGENTS.md communicates durable repository context such as build commands and coding conventions. Task-specific procedures fit skills, external operations fit tools, and no instruction file should be used to escape a sandbox.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: What does a valid Agent Skill grant by itself?
quiz.reference_judgment: The portable artifact supplies metadata and instructions. Discovery, invocation UI, tool access, approvals, and script execution remain runtime responsibilities, so validity is not equivalent to authority.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: What does a successful run of this lesson's stdlib harness prove?
quiz.correct_text: The in-process policy and data flow behaved as asserted
quiz.explanation: The harness uses Python functions, static tokens, fixtures, and in-memory spans. It validates those local boundaries while leaving protocol, authorization, export, browser, and sandbox integration to later tests.
quiz.target: 13. 工具生态原练习与六题答案

quiz.question: Which flow matches MCP revision 2026-07-28 for discovering a server and polling long-running work?
quiz.correct_text: server/discover, tools/call returning a task handle, tasks/get
quiz.explanation: The stateless revision uses mandatory `server/discover`. The optional `io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks` extension returns a task handle and uses `tasks/get`; a terminal task carries its final result. The old handshake, GET endpoint, `tasks/result`, and `tasks/list` are not in this flow.
quiz.target: 13. 工具生态原练习与六题答案

quiz.question: How does A2A v1 name the send-message operation in its gRPC and JSON-RPC bindings?
quiz.explanation: A2A v1 uses `SendMessage` for gRPC and JSON-RPC. Its HTTP+JSON binding exposes `POST /message:send`.
quiz.target: 13. 工具生态原练习与六题答案

quiz.question: Which MCP Apps SDK call lets an App request a tool on its originating server?
quiz.explanation: The App instance calls `callServerTool` with an object containing `name` and optional `arguments`; the host proxies the underlying `tools/call` request.
quiz.target: 13. 工具生态原练习与六题答案

quiz.question: What authority does the capstone Agent Skill provide over MCP tools and the sandbox?
quiz.correct_text: None; host adapters and policy still authorize each capability
quiz.explanation: A skill supplies procedure. Discovery, invocation, tool exposure, authorization, credentials, and isolation are enforced by the host and external runtime boundaries.
quiz.target: 13. 工具生态原练习与六题答案

quiz.question: Which evidence best proves that telemetry crossed the production export boundary?
quiz.correct_text: Receiver-side collector data with trace and parent assertions
quiz.explanation: A receiver-side observation proves the SDK, propagator, exporter, transport, and collector path worked. Local data and diagrams prove only local construction or intent.
quiz.target: 13. 工具生态原练习与六题答案

quiz.question: A host finds the same skill name in project and user scopes. What determines which one wins?
quiz.reference_judgment: The portable skill format does not create one universal precedence order. A host must declare how scopes shadow one another and should report collisions instead of silently relying on filesystem iteration order.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: What belongs in the first discovery catalog sent to a model before implementation?
quiz.reference_judgment: Level-one discovery should carry enough metadata to route a task without loading full instructions. Bodies and referenced resources are disclosed later, which protects the context budget and avoids premature execution.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: Which sequence correctly implements progressive disclosure under this contract?
quiz.reference_judgment: Discovery, activation, and resource loading are separate stages. Each stage spends more context only after the previous stage establishes relevance, so unrelated skill bodies and references remain outside the prompt.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: Why should an equal-precedence duplicate be reported as ambiguous?
quiz.reference_judgment: If two candidates have the same name and policy rank, lexical or iteration order is not meaningful authority. Failing clearly forces the host or user to resolve identity instead of producing environment-dependent behavior.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: A SKILL.md references `references/archive/schema.md` in a bundle that permits only one-level references. What should validation do?
quiz.reference_judgment: A one-level contract allows direct files or paths such as `references/schema.md`, not recursively nested chains. The bound keeps packages inspectable and blocks traversal-like complexity before content is loaded.
quiz.qualification: 课例一层物理目录政策，不是标准禁止任何嵌套目录。

quiz.question: What is the most defensible response when a catalog exceeds its declared context budget?
quiz.reference_judgment: Deterministic truncation or omission makes catalog behavior reproducible and measurable. Reporting omissions preserves observability, while narrower scope or search can retrieve candidates that did not fit the first catalog.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: Which event is an example of programmatic skill activation from the host perspective?
quiz.reference_judgment: Programmatic activation comes from runtime or harness control flow, such as an evaluation selecting an exact skill. Human selection is explicit user activation, while semantic matching is implicit model activation.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: A host recognizes `user-invocable: false`. How should a portability guide describe that field?
quiz.reference_judgment: A particular host can assign meaning to an extension without making it universal. Portable tooling should preserve or explicitly adapt the field and avoid promising identical behavior in runtimes that do not recognize it.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: What should an implicit model router do with a near-miss query below its activation threshold?
quiz.reference_judgment: Near-miss negatives are where over-triggering appears. A threshold is useful only if the router honors it, reports the non-activation, and allows normal reasoning or clarification to continue.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: In the human/model 2x2, what does `human=true, model=false` mean?
quiz.reference_judgment: The axes describe activation channels, not permissions. This quadrant supports deliberate user selection while suppressing automatic model routing, which is useful for costly or disruptive workflows.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: Why does an evaluation harness usually activate a skill by exact name?
quiz.reference_judgment: A harness often needs to test the skill itself, not the discovery model. Exact programmatic selection removes one source of variance; separate trigger evaluations can then measure implicit routing precision and recall.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: Which design keeps invocation and authority correctly separated?
quiz.reference_judgment: Activation decides whether instructions enter context. Permission review decides whether proposed reads, writes, commands, or network calls may occur. Keeping those gates separate prevents discoverability or invocation from becoming accidental authority.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: A SKILL.md says `You may write anywhere on disk`. What authority does that sentence provide?
quiz.reference_judgment: Skill content is instruction data, not a capability token. Filesystem scope, tool access, network policy, and approvals come from the host and remain in force even when the skill claims broader permissions.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: Why must a workspace jail resolve symlinks before checking containment?
quiz.reference_judgment: Checking only the input string misses links such as `workspace/report` that resolve elsewhere. Containment must be evaluated on the resolved target, and conservative systems may reject direct symlink targets entirely.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: An external webpage embedded in a task says to disable approval checks. How should the runtime treat that text in this scenario?
quiz.reference_judgment: External content may inform the task, but it is not part of the trusted policy channel. Requests influenced by it should remain within existing permissions and may deserve an additional approval gate for stateful actions.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: What is the safest educational way to demonstrate destructive-command review?
quiz.reference_judgment: A policy simulator can teach executable allowlists, destructive patterns, metacharacter checks, and verdicts without creating real side effects. The lesson's result should explicitly record that execution never occurred.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: A skill proposes an HTTPS call to an origin outside the network allowlist. The user previously invoked the skill. What is the correct verdict?
quiz.reference_judgment: The invocation gate controls instruction loading, while the network gate controls normalized HTTPS origins, including effective ports. Prior skill selection does not broaden the allowlist or authorize credential transmission.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: What should happen when a write request contains possible secret material and no approved secret-use path exists?
quiz.reference_judgment: Workspace containment does not make secret handling safe. The reviewer should block the request, avoid echoing sensitive material, and require explicit policy and approval before any legitimate secret use.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/06-专题扩展/05-Agent Skills包与运行时.md
exercises.question_zh: 三类各十题怎样分development/holdout？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: 10positive/10negative/10near miss在修描述前分dev/validation，手工gold与competitors明确；数量不是质量标准，固定simulator不能替targethost。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/06-专题扩展/05-Agent Skills包与运行时.md
exercises.question_zh: 五次baseline/treatment怎样报告退步？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: 五次paired每任务保持同模型/工具/预算，保留raw predictions和每case regressions；未做真实API实验。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/06-专题扩展/05-Agent Skills包与运行时.md
exercises.question_zh: human rubric怎样校准？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: 人类rubric需五example校准judge/human一致与failureboundaries，不把任何LLM“感觉好”作机械通过。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/06-专题扩展/05-Agent Skills包与运行时.md
exercises.question_zh: 新增hostcapability如何给四种兼容结果？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: 加hostcapability明确native/adapter/degraded/unsupported与fallback是否满足required；没有hostprobe仅fixture。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/06-专题扩展/05-Agent Skills包与运行时.md
exercises.question_zh: 安装后reference改变应怎样拒绝？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: manifest后改reference，应mismatched并在activation前挡；manifest本身由外围渠道auth，不能recompute后冒称未改。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/06-专题扩展/05-Agent Skills包与运行时.md
exercises.question_zh: body过lint而script坏artifact是谁阻发布？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: bodylint过scriptartifact失败应scripts/behavior阻发布，各层并列不能加权抵消。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/06-专题扩展/05-Agent Skills包与运行时.md
exercises.question_zh: 升级怎样比invocation policy与capabilities？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: 升级diff invocationpolicy/required capabilities及新resource，重新验目标host/权限，避免silent degradation。

exercises.formal_file: Agentic Design Patterns/06-专题扩展/05-Agent Skills包与运行时.md
exercises.question_zh: 兼容报告怎样避免一个portable badge掩盖未知？
exercises.answer_or_criterion: compatibility report含version/date/evidence/未验证；本次未publish、install、upgrade、uninstall，模拟passed不记录用户技能。

quiz.question: Which evaluation set best reveals whether a skill description over-triggers in the lesson model?
quiz.reference_judgment: Easy positives measure whether the intended task can trigger. Near-miss negatives measure whether adjacent tasks trigger incorrectly, which is necessary to calculate false positives and precision.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: A trigger test has 8 true positives and 2 false positives. What is its precision?
quiz.reference_judgment: Precision is true positives divided by all predicted positives: 8 / (8 + 2) = 0.8. Recall needs the false-negative count, which this scenario does not provide.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: Why compare baseline and with-skill artifacts using the same assertions?
quiz.reference_judgment: Activation is not the outcome. A shared artifact contract tests whether loading the skill changes required headings, evidence, schema, or forbidden content while keeping the measurement comparable to baseline.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: A host loads SKILL.md but drops `references/` and `scripts/` during installation. How should a portability matrix classify a bundle that requires both?
quiz.reference_judgment: The host understands the core file, so it is not wholly unsupported. It still cannot satisfy the package's declared requirements natively, and the matrix should name the exact adapter work instead of flattening portability to yes or no.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: What does a repeated-run rate add beyond one passing trigger evaluation?
quiz.reference_judgment: A single run can hide nondeterminism. Per-case repeated-run rates reveal flaky activation or artifact production, while structural lint, runtime permissions, and host adapters remain separate concerns.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.question: Which release gate is most complete for an Agent Skill bundle?
quiz.reference_judgment: The six layers are package structure; trigger routing with precision, recall, and repeated-run stability; instruction and artifact behavior; script correctness; safety and authority; and packaging plus portability, including a manifest-verified clean install. Every layer must pass. Source-bound local digests detect mismatches but can be recomputed with relabeled fixtures, so production readiness also requires an external attestation whose exact trusted SHA-256 binds the complete evidence root.
quiz.qualification: 题目只证明概念判断；不证明用户答过、实做或掌握。

quiz.source_question: A mutation response is lost and the client retries with a new JSON-RPC id. What makes the retry safe?
source_options: The new JSON-RPC id automatically deduplicates the mutation
The tool descriptor includes an idempotentHint
A durable application idempotency key reused with identical arguments
The retry uses the same HTTP connection
quiz.source_reference_answer: A durable application idempotency key reused with identical arguments
quiz.source_explanation: JSON-RPC ids correlate messages. Business idempotency requires a durable key, an argument fingerprint, and a stored committed result.
quiz.judgment_criterion: durable业务key+相同参数fingerprint才条件retry，RPCid不去重

quiz.source_question: A subscription SSE stream drops after several progress events. Which recovery plan fits MCP 2026-07-28?
source_options: Resume from Last-Event-ID and replay every in-flight mutation
Open a GET event stream and restore Mcp-Session-Id
Keep the old request id and assume no updates were lost
Open a new listen request, refetch authoritative state, and avoid unsafe mutation replay

quiz.source_explanation: Modern MCP streams are not resumable with Last-Event-ID. Recovery uses a new request plus authoritative refetch and explicit retry safety.

quiz.question: What does successful publication in an MCP Registry establish for a production gateway?
options: The record passed Registry publication controls, while local runtime admission is still required
The live endpoint exactly matches the published package
The newest version should immediately replace every older route
The server is safe for every principal
quiz.source_explanation: Registry publication establishes publication facts. Artifact, runtime, authorization, and local approval checks remain separate.
quiz.answer_zh: A：通过发布控制；仍需本地artifact、live descriptor、权限与准入检查。

targets.heading: 6.6 五课30道自检题的中文参考判断

quiz.question: Which namespace comparison rejects com.exampleevil/tool when the verified namespace is com.example?
options: Check whether the whole name starts with com.example
Search for the substring example
Split at the slash and compare the namespace segment exactly
Trust the namespace written inside server.json
quiz.source_explanation: An exact segment comparison preserves the namespace boundary and uses authority supplied by a trusted verifier.
quiz.answer_zh: C：取`/`前完整namespace与可信认证结果精确比，不能startsWith。

targets.heading: 6.6 五课30道自检题的中文参考判断

quiz.question: A live server adds a new tool while its Registry record and package coordinate stay unchanged. Which evidence detects this?
options: A fresh normalized descriptor digest compared with the admitted toolset pin
The Registry publication timestamp
The namespace authentication method
The semantic version string alone
quiz.source_explanation: Live descriptor pinning detects behavior drift that publication metadata and package coordinates cannot show.
quiz.answer_zh: A：新规范化toolset摘要与准入pin比较；版本字符串不能检测。

targets.file: Agentic Design Patterns/06-专题扩展/07-工具授权与发布治理.md
targets.heading: 6.6 五课30道自检题的中文参考判断

quiz.question: What should happen when an admitted Registry version changes from active to deprecated?
options: Quarantine it from new routing and retain the historical admission evidence
Rewrite the published record back to active
Delete all evidence so clients cannot discover it
Ignore status because package ownership was already verified
quiz.source_explanation: Status is operational input. Quarantine stops new use while retained evidence supports audit and rollback analysis.
quiz.answer_zh: A：本课治理政策隔离新路由并保历史证据，不能改写Registry状态或删证据。

targets.file: Agentic Design Patterns/06-专题扩展/07-工具授权与发布治理.md
targets.heading: 6.6 五课30道自检题的中文参考判断

quiz.question: Which target is eligible for an automatic rollback?
options: Any version whose name sorts before the candidate
A previously admitted pin that is active under policy, healthy, and not quarantined
The version marked latest, even if it was never reviewed
A deleted Registry version with a familiar package name
quiz.source_explanation: Rollback restores a known admissible route. It does not bypass current status, health, or quarantine checks.
quiz.answer_zh: B：已准入、当前政策允许、active、healthy且未quarantine的精确pin。

targets.file: Agentic Design Patterns/06-专题扩展/07-工具授权与发布治理.md
targets.heading: 6.6 五课30道自检题的中文参考判断

quiz.question: Why should admission ledger heads be anchored in a separate trust domain?
options: It makes artifact digests unnecessary
It lets publishers set Registry-managed status
It converts mutable version ranges into exact pins
A local hash chain detects edits, while a separate anchor makes a complete local rewrite detectable
quiz.source_explanation: An attacker who can rewrite the whole local ledger can recompute its chain. An external signed or write-once anchor exposes that rewrite.
quiz.answer_zh: D：本地整链可重写并重算hash；独立信任域签名或只写anchor让重写可发现。
